description: TP2 Qwen MTP5/tree7 with parent-aware attention whenever the whole batch selects the ordinary prefill band. Pure decode through five rows keeps the existing masked decode kernel. The private attention row retains BF16 queries/output and FP8 KV, with FP32 dot products, softmax, PV and split partials. This also fixes the pre-existing small-tree prefill path that ignored ancestor masks; that incorrect path is not a parity oracle. No new quantization or reduced-precision intermediate is introduced. This declaration is not a gate PASS or a performance claim.
